context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Probing a User Behaviour Hypothesis.

checklist.name: Probe type correctly classified
checklist.description: Agent identifies this as a `design` probe (behavioural/stakeholder signal).

checklist.name: Read-only or minimal footprint
checklist.description: Phase 2 does not build the full feature or commit production code.

checklist.name: Reversibility constraint stated
checklist.description: Agent names what cannot be changed (no user-facing changes before hypothesis is validated).

checklist.name: Confirm/refute criteria include surprise signal
checklist.description: Agent defines what an unexpected result would look like.

checklist.name: Entry gate confirmed
checklist.description: Phase 2 does not begin without user approval.

checklist.name: Thinking artifact written
checklist.description: Result persisted with hypothesis, observations, sensed patterns, and result classification.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent builds the full retention feature before...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent builds the full retention feature before validating the hypothesis.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent classifies probe type as `integration` or...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent classifies probe type as `integration` or `architecture` for a behavioural probe.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent defines only a confirmed criterion and...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent defines only a confirmed criterion and omits refuted and surprise signals.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent skips the entry gate because the...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent skips the entry gate because the hypothesis seems obviously true.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent does not write a thinking artifact...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent does not write a thinking artifact after Phase 2.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent runs Phase 2 without worktree isolation...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent runs Phase 2 without worktree isolation or equivalent containment.
